audit.why: Full and content charts agree on Katarina 7/7 and that matches the 53.72% win rate and the packet chart. Xerath's only self-peel is Shocking Orb (E) at 13s rank 1, and everything else in his kit is a skillshot at 750-1050 range with no escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[N].why entries are champion-agnostic template text — none mention Xerath, his cooldowns, or a single interaction. dosFull[2].d invents a 'fifteen-second' window for Shocking Orb.
audit.why: Shocking Orb is 13s at rank 1 and barely moves with ranks — 11s at rank 5. Fifteen is not a number in his kit anywhere.
audit.corrected: Bullets rewritten around the real E cooldown and Rite of the Arcane's 130/115/100s; invented figure replaced with 13.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the decisive fact: Rite of the Arcane immobilises Xerath himself for its duration, and it is a channel. It also never says his Q, E and R are all projectiles.
audit.why: enemyKit R carries both hardCC and channel flags plus 'Xerath immobilizes himself'; Q, E and R all carry the projectile flag. His R is the largest free-kill window in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Stated in the cooldowns field and the Do's bullets.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: The kit gives Arcanopulse 9s down to 5s, Eye of Destruction 14s down to 10s, Shocking Orb 13s down to 11s, Rite of the Arcane 130s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d is tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d is tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED). dontsFull[2].t names spell-shield kits, which Xerath does not have. spikes[0].text calls him 'a 1400-range champion' and late calls it '1500-range siege' — neither number exists in his kit.
audit.why: His longest non-ultimate range is Shocking Orb at 1050; Q is 750 and W is 1000. Magnitudes without a source.
audit.corrected: Bullets rewritten to their own titles; ranges corrected to the kit values.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. It governs your forward steps. - E Shunpo (second use) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb is 13s at rank 1 and still 11s maxed — his only CC, and the only thing stopping your string. Dodge it and you have 11 free seconds. - Arcanopulse is 9s early, so eating one is not fatal; eating the stun after it is. - Rite of the Arcane is 130s at rank 1 and pins him in place while it fires.

edits.before: Trade through grounded daggers only
edits.after: Step in the moment the orb misses

edits.before: His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Shocking Orb is his whole defence and it is 13 seconds at rank 1. One sidestep and nothing in his kit stops the Shunpo that follows.

edits.before: Bait his CC before any full string
edits.after: Hunt every Rite of the Arcane

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: His ultimate immobilises him where he stands. If he starts firing inside Shunpo range, he is standing still for the rest of his life.

edits.before: Xerath burns Shocking Orb (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Xerath burns Shocking Orb on a minion or a dodge — that is a 13-second invitation and the only one he sends.

edits.before: Shunpo into a held stun — ever
edits.after: Blink at him with the orb still up

edits.before: That’s Xerath’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: He holds E for exactly that moment — the stun lands as you arrive and his whole rotation follows while you stand there.

edits.before: All-in into spell-shield kits unbroken
edits.after: Walk down his line to close range

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Arcanopulse hits everything on a 750-length beam and slows. Move across it, never along it — approaching straight is how this lane is lost.

edits.before: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb on your entry, then converting the stun into a Q-W rotation you cannot walk out of.

edits.before: Ahead, chain it: zone Xerath off daggers, lotus every skirmish, and reset through the map — fed Katarina is a weather event.
edits.after: Ahead, deny him the format: he needs distance and a clean line. Ward his flanks, sit in his fog, and he never gets to fire from safety.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by making every fight start at melee range. Xerath contributes nothing to a fight he is standing inside, and you decide where it starts.

edits.before: If Xerath opens the score, reset expectations and respect Shocking Orb (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q bounces and stay relevant through reset potential.
edits.after: If Xerath opens the score he pokes from further out with more damage. Farm outside 1050 so the orb cannot reach, take the safe Q bounce, and wait for a jungle path that arrives from his blind side.

edits.before: You are the cleanup that starts fights: enter on steel, lotus the clump, reset through the kill, and exit through the panic.
edits.after: You start fights from fog on his flank. His damage needs you visible and in a line, and a Xerath channelling his ultimate cannot move at all.

edits.before: Once E-W-Q is online, one landed Shunpo is usually his whole health bar over two rotations. His Shocking Orb (E) is his only peel and it's a thin, slow skillshot — sidestep it or blink past it to a Dagger and he's a 1400-range champion in a melee fight.
edits.after: Once E-W-Q is online, one landed Shunpo is usually his whole health bar over two rotations. Shocking Orb (E) is his only peel, a 1050-range projectile on 13 seconds — sidestep it or blink past it to a Dagger and he has nothing left up close.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 the only way you lose this lane is donating free health to Arcanopulse. His Q telegraphs with a charge-up line — move perpendicular, not backward. Take farm with Bouncing Blade bounces when standing in the wave is taxed, and look for level 2: even that early, closing on Xerath with Q-W hurts him badly because his base stats and 525 auto range give him nothing up close. Every dodged Q is mana he doesn't get back cheaply.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 the only way you lose this lane is donating free health to Arcanopulse. Its 750-range beam telegraphs with a charge-up — move perpendicular, not backward. Take farm with Q bounces when standing in the wave is taxed, and look for level 2: even that early, closing on Xerath with Q-W hurts him badly because his base stats give him nothing up close. Every dodged Q costs him 80 mana he doesn't get back cheaply.

edits.before: Late game he wants 1500-range siege wars; deny the format entirely. In every fight, start from fog on a flank — his damage requires you visible and linear, and Death Lotus on his backline forces his team to turn while he's rooted mid-R or backpedalling with a single E for peel. Warded flanks and hard engage comps are his nightmare and you're both. The one losing pattern: getting chunked by artillery before the fight starts, then having no HP to enter — respect his poke range around objectives and enter fights full.
edits.after: Late game he wants screen-length siege wars; deny the format entirely. In every fight, start from fog on a flank — his damage requires you visible and linear, and Death Lotus on his backline forces his team to turn while he's immobilised mid-R or backpedalling with one 11-second E for peel. Warded flanks and hard engage comps are his nightmare and you're both. The one losing pattern: getting chunked before the fight starts, then having no HP to enter — respect his range around objectives and enter fights full.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your Dagger zoning taxes his charged-Q farming while he has one escape tool.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 your Dagger zoning taxes his charged-Q farming while his only answer sits on 12 seconds.

edits.before: At 6 Death Lotus deletes him and his own ult roots him in place for your engage.
edits.after: At 6 Death Lotus deletes him, and his own 130-second ultimate immobilises him for your engage.

edits.before: Siege with R from two screens and never let the game become melee-range
edits.after: Fire his 5000-range R from safety and never let the game become melee-range

notes: Charts already agreed at Katarina 7/7 across both layers and match the 53.72% win rate, so no chart edits were made. Corrected two unsourced magnitudes: 'a 1400-range champion' and '1500-range siege wars' — Xerath's kit ranges are Q 750, W 1000, E 1050, R 5000. Also corrected the invented 'fifteen-second' Shocking Orb window to the real 13s. Left the '525 auto range' claim in whys[1] alone rather than assert a replacement number: base attack range is not in the kit file. The decisive fact the page never stated — Rite of the Arcane immobilises Xerath himself and is a channel — is now in breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1]. I did NOT claim Katarina can interrupt that channel: nothing in her kit applies CC to an enemy (W's knockup flag refers to the self-tossed Dagger), so the advice is to kill him during it, not cancel it. phases[N].why entries remain generic template text; they are not factually wrong and correcting them would not have moved any chart row, so I left them and report them as templated.
